\]

Start from the difference-to-product identity and then bound each factor:
\[
\begin{aligned}
|\sin x-\sin c|
&=\left|2\sin\Big(\frac{x-c}{2}\Big)\cos\Big(\frac{x+c}{2}\Big)\right|\\
&=2\left|\sin\Big(\frac{x-c}{2}\Big)\right|\,\left|\cos\Big(\frac{x+c}{2}\Big)\right|\\
&\le 2\left|\sin\Big(\frac{x-c}{2}\Big)\right| \quad (|\cos(\cdot)|\le 1)\\
&\le 2\left|\frac{x-c}{2}\right| \quad (|\sin t|\le |t|)\\
&=|x-c|.
\end{aligned}
\]

\cos(x_n)=\sin\Big(x_n+\frac{\pi}{2}\Big)\to \sin\Big(c+\frac{\pi}{2}\Big)=\cos(c),
\]
